text:
marta: handing off from EU evening shift. saw a P1 page 30m before my shift ended for embeddings latency spikes. paging to @lee as primary for the next 8h. summary below

incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: embeddings-latency-high (sev=2). triggered at 2026-03-14T18:12:10Z. affected service: /v1/embeddings; error rate up, tail latency increased.

marta: short notes — root cause suspected kv-cache thrash on dedicated pools during a backup window. we mitigated with temporary cache eviction + routing to warm pools, reduced error rate to baseline. left small risk: EU pool 3 still shows elevated 95p latency (+40ms).

lee: thanks. i'm primary. can you drop the immediate runbook link and steps you ran?

marta: sure — runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash. steps I ran:
1) run `kubectl -n rw-system exec -it cache-pod -- /usr/local/bin/evict-prefix --age 600` to clear old prefixes
2) set routing override: `robin set-route embeddings eu-pool1,eu-pool2`
3) temporarily disabled backups for pool3 via ops UI (backup-schedule -> pause)

marta: logs I grabbed:
```
Mar 14 18:09:02 cache-pod-3 kernel: oom-killer invoked
Mar 14 18:09:03 redis: eviction triggered: prefix_count=1.2M -> 600k
Mar 14 18:10:27 serving: request.latency_p95 increased from 42ms -> 86ms
```

lee: good context. i'll watch for customers. which tenants were impacted?

marta: two mid-market customers saw tail latencies > 500ms and some 429s for long-batch embedding jobs: tenant alice-analytics and tenant beta-search. notified CS and assigned temporary SLA waivers. tickets created: RDW-4512 (alice-analytics) and RDW-4513 (beta-search).

sam: pinging CS here — can you confirm messages sent and any escalation?

dena: CS ack — both customers contacted via email at 18:40 UTC, TL;DR + incident owner and ETA to restore normal performance. we offered taskforce support; both accepted ETA window. putting follow-up notes in each ticket.

lee: ok i'm taking primary. i'm setting myself as pager contact in PagerDuty and adding @sam as secondary for the next 4 hours in case I get pulled into another meeting.

oncall-bot: pager updated: primary=lee, secondary=sam for rotation window 2026-03-14T18:45Z -> 2026-03-15T02:45Z.

lee: current open action items for handoff:
- continue watching pool3 KV eviction metrics (dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/kv/eviction-eu3)
- if p95 > 120ms re-route additional traffic to warm pools (run `robin add-route eu-pool2`)
- file infra ticket to add guardrail to prevent backup overlap with eviction windows (RDW-4514)

marta: filed RDW-4514 and left detailed reproduction steps + query to identify other pools at risk.

ops-docs-bot: note appended to runbook kv-cache-thrash: "added extra verification step to check backup schedules before eviction" by marta at 2026-03-14T18:52Z.

lee: quick check — coverage gap: APAC night shift will start in ~3 hours, but there's no dedicated secondary for EU -> APAC handover because sam is on-call in MEA. can we get a volunteer for the overlap window 01:00-02:00 UTC?

dena: i can cover that overlap 01:00-02:00 UTC if needed.

lee: perfect, thx dena. adding as interim backup in PagerDuty and noting in the handoff.

marta: final notes before I step out: follow-up retro scheduled, 1h async + 30m live. proposing 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. please add any postmortem bullets to RDW-4512/4513/4514 and tag with "kv-cache".

sam: added tentative retro invite and assigned draft owner for postmortem: lee. I'll draft customer-facing timeline once we have full logs.

lee: thanks team. i'll keep monitoring and post status updates here. if I escalate to sev1, i'll page infra and mark the thread.

marta: thanks — handing off. :wave:

lee: handoff ack — taking over. :thumbsup:
